restaurantName: Ngao Kei Ka Lei Chon (1 Rua de Cinco de Outubro)
address: GF, 1 Rua de Cinco de Outubro, Macau, Macau
bio: Don’t judge a book by its cover because the underwhelming signs outside reflect neither the quality of the food nor the service in this friendly, well-run noodle shop. The key draw is the swimmer crab congee – crabs are dressed on the spot and burst with seafood umami, while the creamy congee is rich in crab roe aromas. Curried beef brisket, noodles tossed in crab roe sauce and springy pan-fried cuttlefish patties are other standouts.
pageTitle: Ngao Kei Ka Lei Chon (1 Rua de Cinco de Outubro)
